votes.motion: Johnny Loumis moved to approve the minutes from the June 17, 2020, meeting of the Planning Commission

Debbie Cragun moved to table this item until the next Planning Commission Meeting scheduled for August 19, 2020, so that the Commission has time to re-read the text that is being recommended in light of new information presented at this meeting and to come back with suggestions, recommendations, and questions for staff at the next meeting. Staff was also directed to reach out to the absent Commission Members to let them know of the assignment
